html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Heroes chosen by Agents at the Hero Update Voting Event held last December

have arrived in a more powerful form!

 

We introduce the May Update in celebration of

the addition of the Sentry and the Challengers.

 

Sentry has merged with the Void and achieved new power,

receiving Tier-4 Advancement and a new Uniform.

Various Super Heroes and Super Villains have gathered

to challenge him who has obtained the power of the Void!

 

Thor and Hulk are equipped with new Uniforms

and will be supported by the Avengers Part.1 Team-Up Collection.

 

In addition, note that Anti-man, who can freely absorb and manipulate Anti-Matter energy,

has received Tier-3 Advancement and a new Uniform as well.

 

Lastly, Agents can now participate in more battles with heroes

through improvements for the balance of PvP content

and Alliance Battle re-challenges, so please check the details below!

 

▣ Four New Uniforms

 

Four new Uniforms have been added in celebration of

the Sentry and the Challengers-themed Update.

Check out the abilities of Sentry <Darkness Merged>, Hulk <Titan>,

Thor <All-Father Reborn>, and Anti-Man <Ultimates>.

* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.
(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

* The four new Uniforms will be on sale for 50% off

during the <9-Year Anniversary Sales Festival!>, and can be checked and purchased

in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Sentry Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to Sentry, who strives

to become a true hero while suppressing his dark side.

* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Anti-Man Tier-3

 

With the addition of the Tier-3 Ultimate Skill,

Anti-Man can now control a wider variety of Anti-Matter energies!

 

 

 

 

▣ Fandral, Volstagg, and Hogun Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the May Update, Fandral, Volstagg, and Hogun

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ PvP Content Balance Adjustments

 

The balance for PvP content has been adjusted

so that Agents can participate in more battles with various heroes.

 

1. The rate of Additional Pierce Damage stat applied in PvP content has been adjusted.

- Applied Contents: Timeline Battle, Alliance Conquest, Otherworld Battle

- Additional Pierce Damage stat has been adjusted as follows.

 

 

2. The number of ‘Debuffed Characters’ selections for Otherworld Battle has been added.

Before: 3 heroes are selected (Based on the first round / a maximum of 6 heroes are maintained)

After: 8 heroes are selected (Based on the first round / a maximum of 16 heroes are maintained)

 

3. The following have been applied to Timeline Battle.

- At the start of the battle, the cooldown time penalty for the attacker's

Active Skill 1 - 4 is reduced, and the defender is given a small penalty.

- The skill cooldown time has been removed for both the attacker and the defender

after tagging a hero, and the invincible time after tagging has been reduced.

- The attacker and defender's HP and Defense have been adjusted

to have more influence than before.

 

 

▣ New Team-Up Collection - Avengers Part.1

 

A New Team-Up collection has been added.

Upgrade the target heroes and Uniforms, and acquire various options that will help your battles.

 

 

 

 

▣ Alliance Battle Improvements

 

New rewards have been added!

Keep challenging yourself to obtain higher score rewards.

 

1. Collection Token: Guardians of the Galaxy has been added

to the Small / Medium Collection Token Supply Chest.

 

2. Agents can now obtain the remaining rewards even with the record challenge 
if the Score Rewards list remains after completing the initial challenge.

- Rewards already obtained during the initial challenge cannot be obtained again 
even if you proceed with the record challenge.
- This feature only applies in Extreme and Legend mode.

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Sentry, Anti-Man,

Fandral, Volstagg, and Hogun have been added.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

 

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.

- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase

when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, one as an Otherworld Battle reward,

and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[May Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms of the Sentry and the Challengers theme.

Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward!

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The list of completion rewards in the [Challenges → Daily] tab has been changed and improved.

- Daily Challenge Reward: 15 Energy → 20 Energy

- Weekly Challenge Reward: Clear Ticket x45 → 1,000,000 Gold / 200,000 Gold → 2,000,000 Gold

 

 

2. The UI of the [Comic Cards → Card Collection] has been improved.

- If you have cards that are not registered in the Card Collection 

and are of Legend grade and meet the conditions to upgrade to Mythic grade, 

a notification mark (red dot) will be displayed on the theme and card.

Through the ‘Enhance and Register’ button, you can quickly register the card to the corresponding theme.

 

 

3. The balance of the World Boss Conquer Level has been improved.

- The Conquer Level effect of the previous bosses increases the Instinct Damage 
when playing a Legend+ difficulty World Boss.

 

Ex) The Conquer effect applied when challenging Legend+ Black Swan

▶ Before:

Kang the Conqueror - Basic Damage dealt increased / Black Swan - Basic Damage dealt increased

▶ After:

Kang the Conqueror - Instinct Damage dealt increased / Black Swan - Basic Damage dealt increased

 

4. Inventory slots can be expanded up to 1,200.

 

5. Dormammu's HP in Giant Boss Raid has been decreased.

 

6. The sorting rule for the Uniforms in [Uniform → Recommended Uniforms] 

and [All Uniforms] has been improved.

- Uniforms are now sorted in the following order:

Favorite, New, Discount, Recommended, Unowned, and Owned

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. A network error code pop-up screen being displayed when entering World Boss: Legend+ <Black Swan> with a hero lower than Tier-4 using the Team Bonus per Character feature has been fixed.


2. The attack pattern of the boss (Maximus) not being shown properly in the Story: Ultimate [10-2 The Brink of Detonation] stage has been fixed.


3. The red dot alert not disappearing even when the Otherworld Battle challenge has been completed has been fixed.


4. The 10 Crystal rewards for the [Recommended Goal - Tier-4 Character] in Jocasta’s Need Help? screen not being acquired in certain circumstances has been fixed.
 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
